'''Bain''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Black Rock]] [[sept]] of the [[Shaarad]] [[Aiel]]. She is bonded as a [[first-sister]] to [[Chiad]].

== Appearance ==
Bain is tall, with fiery red hair and dark blue eyes. She is taller than Chiad. She has sun-darkened skin and short-cropped hair.

== Activities ==
=== Tear ===
She meets [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] on their way to [[Tear]]. She leads them to [[Dailin (maiden)|Dailin]] who has been injured.{{ref/book|3|38}} They reveal they are searching for "He Who Comes With the Dawn". She is one of the Aiel present when the [[Stone of Tear]] falls.

=== The Two Rivers ===
She leaves with [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile Bashere]] when she goes to the [[Two Rivers]] to meet the [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]].{{ref/book|4|18}} She arrives with Faile and the [[Deven Ride]] men when the [[Trolloc]]s were attacking [[Emond's Field]].

She accompanies Faile when she goes with Perrin to meet [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Caemlyn]]. She is Rand's guard when he is taken by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]].
=== Made ''gai'shain'' ===
[[File:Bain and Chiad by googoolini.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Pencil sketch of Bain and Chiad by Googolini]]She then moves out with Perrin and Faile when they [[Traveling|Travel]] to [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]].
While out hunting, she is captured by the [[Shaido]] and made ''[[gai'shain]]''.
[[File:Wot gaul chaid bain by reddera-d4rxvmq.jpg|thumb|308x308px|Bain with Chiad and Gaul by Ariel Burgess, Official Wheel of Time Artist]]


She helps [[Arrela Shiego]] and [[Lacile Aldorwin]] escape the Shaido camp but refuses to escape herself.
She and Chiad help Faile by making sure a captive [[Dairaine Saighan]] doesn't run to [[Sevanna]] to inform her of Faile's planned escape.

During the [[Battle of Malden]], [[Gaul]] rescues Chiad but kills the man who had Bain as his ''gai'shain''. They now both serve him. She recovers some clothing of [[Rolan]], [[Kinhuin]], and [[Jhoradin]] so that Faile can carry out a funeral service for the fallen men.

Bain offers Gaul some freshly sharpened spears the day of Perrin's trial. She Travels through with Perrin and the rest of his huge force to the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]]. Bain and Chiad watch Gaul leave through the gateway with Perrin, in their attempt to stop [[Slayer]].

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Bain}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Ragga Ragnars}}.
